rule: Ordered keyless public JSON-RPC endpoints per chain. Reads try them in order and fall through on any HTTP or JSON-RPC error (rate limits included). A block is pinned only when one operator reports it under the finalized tag AND a second, different operator (registrable domain) returns the same hash at that height; otherwise the read is UNMEASURED. No endpoint here needs a key. Order was set from a live probe from the build pod on 2026-09-28: finalized tag, pinned eth_call by number and by EIP-1898 block hash, per endpoint.
read_by: functions/api/wrapper.ts (the /api/wrapper door and the per-asset doors)

ethereum.notes: rpc.flashbots.net answered the finalized tag but refused eth_call (HTTP 403) on 2026-09-28, so it is last: it can confirm a block hash, not serve a read. eth.llamarpc.com answered 525 and eth.merkle.io 429; both left out.

base.notes: base-rpc.publicnode.com refused eth_call by block number (403) and accepted it by block hash on 2026-09-28; 1rpc.io/base rate-limited (429).

optimism.notes: optimism-rpc.publicnode.com refused eth_call by block number (403) on 2026-09-28.

arbitrum.notes: arbitrum.drpc.org answered eth_call with HTTP 400 and arbitrum-one-rpc.publicnode.com refused historical state on 2026-09-28; both still confirm block hashes.

polygon.notes: polygon-rpc.com answers 401 without a key since 2026-09; left out.
